title: The Sales Representative removal warning still shows when switched off
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician off, enrolled at the test location only, with Sales Representative on.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  2. Switch Sales Representative off.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window shows Sales Representative on.

Step 2:

  • The existing Sales Representative removal warning shows at once, as today.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member), story SV-11880 (Story 2, Warning before turning Technician off)

  • S2-E3: “Turning off Sales Representative still shows its existing removal warning at the moment that toggle is switched off, as today; the Turn Off Technician warning shows only on Save. Cancelling the Turn Off Technician warning cancels the whole save, including a Sales Representative removal already confirmed, and the window stays open as the user left it.”
  • Out of Scope: “Billable and Sales Representative. No new rules: anyone can still be billable or a sales representative, technician or not, and Technician never changes either of them. Billable keeps doing only what it does today (stamping new time as billable or not, and the Technician Utilization report filter).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
